To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the proposed streaming decoding algorithm achieves similar offline ASR results compared with offline decoding, that it is significantly better than the CTC prefix beam decoder alone and that it achieves better results than the offline CTC attention based decoding algorithm.

the proposed CTC triggered attention based decoder enables streaming recognition with attention based ASR models, and that the proposed pre training method improves the performance of streaming ASR models.
the proposed joint CTC attention decoding algorithm is able to achieve streaming recognition with similar offline results compared to the offline CTC attention decoder.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a fully streaming ASR system with a single encoder neural network and a one pass decoding scheme that is based on CTC prefix beam and triggered attention decoding.
streaming recognition with joint CTC and attention based end-to-end ASR models
the development and analysis of a new decoding algorithm for attention based streaming ASR systems and the improvement of the streaming end to end encoder neural network architecture.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we are able to achieve a fully streaming CTC attention based end to speech recognition system, which achieves state of the art ASR results on the Wall Street Journal corpus.
the proposed joint CTC and attention decoding scheme achieves the best performance compared to all other decoding methods.

the proposed joint CTC and attention based streaming decoding algorithm, which is a combination of the CTC prefix beam and attention based decoding algorithms, is a promising new decoding algorithm for end to end streaming speech recognition.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the CTC prefix beam decoding algorithm is a good choice to enable streaming recognition of attention decoders, and that our PTDLSTM based encoder architecture and the proposed residual connections pre training method are good choices for streaming end to end speech recognition.

we are now able to train and decode a streaming end to end attention based ASR system with joint CTC attention decoding that achieves similar offline ASR results as the best offline end to end ASRs reported in recent literature.
we have achieved streaming ASR with a single model, which is comparable to the best offline CTC attention based ASR models in literature.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the combination of a CTC prefix beam decoder with a CTC attention decoder can be used to improve the decoding performance of attention based end to End ASR systems, which is especially beneficial for streaming recognition.
joint CTC triggered streaming attention decoding is a promising approach for achieving streaming end to end automatic transcription of speech.
the CTC triggered decoding scheme can be applied to any attention based ASR system to enable fully streaming end to End ASR.
